questions.question: Can an operator click the same passwordless sign-in link a second time?
questions.expected_answer: A sign-in link can be used only once.

questions.question: A service token appeared in a client log. What response is prescribed?
questions.expected_answer: Rotate a token immediately if it appears in a client log.

questions.question: Is scheduled maintenance included in the monthly case-search availability objective?
questions.expected_answer: Scheduled maintenance is excluded from the monthly availability objective.

questions.question: If I resubmit yesterday's import key within twenty-four hours, is a different result created?
questions.expected_answer: Submitting the same import key within twenty-four hours returns the original import result.

questions.question: For how many days can I download the rows rejected by an import preview?
questions.expected_answer: Rejected rows remain available for download for seven days.

questions.question: May a Viewer edit routing rules or change case ownership?
questions.expected_answer: Viewers cannot change case ownership or edit routing rules.

questions.question: Which queue receives a newly created case marked security?
questions.expected_answer: A case marked security is assigned to the Security Response queue.

questions.question: How soon must an Operator assign a case waiting in General Review?
questions.expected_answer: Operators must assign General Review cases within one business day.

questions.question: What must be true before an incident is closed?
questions.expected_answer: Close an incident only after the service is stable and follow-up work has an owner.

questions.question: Should quality review scores be interpreted as customer satisfaction measurements?
questions.expected_answer: Quality review scores are not a customer satisfaction measurement.

questions.question: Do notifications expose attachment text or access tokens?
questions.expected_answer: Notifications do not contain attachment text or access tokens.

questions.question: Does a deletion audit event retain the deleted summary text?
questions.expected_answer: The audit event never stores the deleted summary text.

questions.question: Give both the retention period for approved reports and the lifetime of an export link.
questions.expected_answer: Approved reports are retained for 90 days after generation; an export link expires after twenty-four hours.

questions.question: Compare the retry count for a transient ingestion downstream failure with the retry count for a notification delivery failure.
questions.expected_answer: The ingestion worker retries up to three times; a notification delivery failure is retried twice.
